metadata.title: Dr. Syed HASSAN ALI through Attorney- vs IMAMIA DARUL UFTA AND SHARIAT BOARD EDARAE TABLEAGUE ULOOM MUHAMMAD AND ALE MUHAMMAD TRUST Registered through Chairman and 2 others-

full_text:
2008 C L C 130

[Karachi]

Before Gulzar
Ahmed, J

Dr. Syed HASSAN ALI through Attorney----Plaintiff

Versus

IMAMIA DARUL UFTA AND SHARIAT BOARD EDARAE
TABLEAGUE ULOOM MUHAMMAD AND ALE MUHAMMAD TRUST Registered through Chairman and
2 others----Defendants

Suit No.1471 and C.M.As. Nos.8779 and 8670 of 2006,
decided on 9th April, 2007.

West Pakistan Family Courts Act (XXXV of 1964)---

----S. 5 & Schedule---Suit for dissolution of
marriage---Plaintiff had filed a Tasdiqnama issued by the Nazim Union Council
declaring-Talaq given by the plaintiff to the daughter of defendant to have
become effective---Counsel for defendants made statement that in view of
certificate issued by the Union Council, defendants would not press their case
and they would accept the dissolution of marriage between the plaintiff and
daughter of defendant---Plaintiff's counsel being satisfied with such statement
of defendant's counsel, did not press the suit---Suit was dismissed as
withdrawn.

Syed Muhammad Kazim for Plaintiff.

Syed Hasan Jafri for Defendants Nos. 1 to 3.

ORDER

GULZAR AHMED, J.----Plaintiff's counsel at the
outset has pointed out through Certificate No.0858, dated 13-12-2006 that he
was enrolled as an Advocate of this Court by the Sindh Bar Council. He has
attached photocopy of such certificate along with his Vakalatnama filed on
17-11-2006. The plaintiff counsel also filed a Tasdiqnama, dated 15-8-2006
issued by the Nazim Union Council No.6, North Nazimabad Town, Karachi declaring
Talaq given by the plaintiff to Tazeen Zehra daughter of Syed Ali Hasnain Naqvi
to have become effective. The counsel for the defendants make a categorical
statement that in view of the certificate issued by the Union Council, the
defendants do not press their letters complained of by the plaintiff and accept
the dissolution of marriage between the plaintiff and Tazeen Zehra. Plaintiff's
counsel is satisfied with such statement of the defendant's counsel and does
not press this suit. The suit is therefore, dismissed as withdrawn. The listed
applications are also dismissed on the above terms.

H.B.T./H-27/K Suit
dismissed.
